changeReasons.sgt_free_inner.clsp: allow one governed SGT owner spend to create an exact allocation output and a governed reserve remainder without introducing discretionary recipients
changeReasons.governance_singleton_inner_v2.clsp: recognize exact SGT sale and grant bills and prevent tracker execution unless the bill-bound governed reserve allocation is co-spent
changeReasons.vault_singleton_inner_v2.clsp: authorize an exact SGT vote-lock co-spend from the existing approved vault without adding another custody puzzle or permitting an SGT transfer
changeReasons.stripe_settlement_receipt_v1.clsp: authenticate one exact validator-quorum Stripe or Base USDC settlement receipt; preserve the SmartDeed offer output; and include the one-use Base result authorization in the SmartDeed settlement announcement before EVM escrow payout
changeReasons.mint_offer_inventory_available_v1.clsp: preserve RC24 AVAILABLE-to-RESERVED custody while committing each SmartDeed reservation to the extended delivery-bound PurchaseArtifactV3 hash
changeReasons.mint_offer_delegate_v5.clsp: deliver one exact already-minted SmartDeed to its artifact-bound approved vault after authenticated Stripe or Base USDC payment and bind the Base offer settlement to the signed one-use result authorization
changeReasons.purchase_batch_settlement_receipt_v1.cls: authenticate one aggregate Stripe or Base USDC payment and atomically expose one technical offer mojo per exact child SmartDeed while emitting the unchanged V5 child settlement announcement for every vault-bound deed
changeReasons.sgt_reserve_inner_v1.clsp: hold the fixed SGT issuance in governed custody, reject non-allocation bills at lock time, and independently require each sale or grant bill to name this exact reserve
changeReasons.sgt_sale_inner_v1.clsp: create a non-discretionary XCH or approved CAT offer, or consume the shared authenticated Stripe/Base receipt, for one exact approved vault, amount, treasury, artifact, and expiry
